notes.title: devlog 1.7.0
notes.content:
**BU Game On! Lost Heaven Station 2024!**

For the past 2nd of December 2024, *Lost Heaven Station* was selected for the BU Game On! Award, and we are proud to announce that we have won the Jury Choices Award, along with a prize of 6,000 Baht. We would like to extend our sincere thanks to all the visitors and supporters who made our time at the BU Game On! exhibition such a rewarding experience. Your support and encouragement have been invaluable to us!

=====================================================

Steam Page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3227980/Lost_Heaven_Station/

=====================================================

As we plan for version 1.7, the main goal is to focus on the station and the life of the crew, creating a more complete picture of the game. Before we dive into the station itself, we aim to introduce parallel elements that will enhance the gameplay, making it more dynamic and adventurous. In this patch (1.7.0), we prioritized developing these parallel elements as part of the main goal.

# **Update Summary 1.7.0H**

**Note:** The parallel system still has some issues, which need to be complete the station first.

### Parallel System: New Transitions and Backgrounds

- **New:** Added parallel backgrounds.
- Transition tunnels now enable transitions between backgrounds.
- Each route can now have a unique parallel background.
- Transition tunnels scale based on the length of the player's carriage.
- The transition tunnel now automatically calculates the optimal starting point for transitions.

### **Event & Route**

- Added new events and concept art
- Introduced a new location.
- Rebalanced route and event.
- The ‘Fading Signal’ event is now recommended to be found at near end of normal route it’s lead to the ‘Lost Heaven’ route for end-game progression.

### **Spawn point**

- Spawn points have been updated to hook to each train.
- Groups can now spawn at the same spawn point.

### **Crew**

- Added new shooting animation.
- Combat calculations now include accuracy, miss, evade, damage, and attack speed.

### **Storage**

- Storage now allows toggling to specify which resources should be stored.
- Resource restrictions can now be set for storage.
- balance storage space

## **Optimization & Bug Fixes**

### **UI panel**

- Improved Room Detail panel to show negative debuffs.
- Enhanced alert UI icon on the top-left panel.
- Added a way to access the Carriage Set panel.
- Left button functionality improved for opening and closing panels.

### **Other**

- Storage functionality fixed.
- Event reader bug fixed.
- Spawn point bug fixed.
- Fixed work positions for cleaning/maintenance tasks.
- Fixed day/night cycle lighting timing.
- Fixed Priority Panel display.
- Fixed issue allowing movement of the train despite being overweight.
- Item detail display bug fixed.

notes.title: devlog 1.6.12 : Tutorial Is Main Experience
notes.content:
Hello, it’s been a while!

After some our review, we've decided to update our devlogs every 2-4 weeks, depending on the readiness. We recommend following along with each major update for the best overview.

In next version 1.7, our main goal is to introduce basic planning features, like life and station systems, to start building a complete picture of the game. By incorporating all core mechanics, we’ll have a solid foundation, allowing us to refine each feature in the future for the best quality and management.

Thanks for your patience!

Update Summary 1.6.12
**Note:** The crew doctor role is still in testing

Tutorial
- Major rework of the tutorial
- For now on, using tutorial steps to guide the main gameplay experience—we recommend starting with the tutorial

Creatures Behavior
- **New:** Creatures (crew and enemies) now have states for downed or dead
- **New:** Crew can now tend to downed crew members (doctor role)
- **New:** Crew members can carry injured crew to a safe location

Event & Route
- Added new events and concept art
- Events and locations can now be fixed within routes
- Rebalanced event dynamics

Sound
- Changed the main background OST

Optimization & Bug Fixes

UI panel
- Improved order UI and build mode experience
- Optimized crafting order functionality
- Added animations for panel opening

Other
- Improved crew force controls
- Fixed issues with selecting crew within selection boxes
- Resolved bugs when switching from sleep to explore
- Fixed event reading/running display
- Fixed abandon carriage errors
- Synchronized animations frames
- Smoother camera movement
- Results now display when adding resources during events or after exploration
- Added ability to pause building construction if not ready to complete
